name: LogoLoop-TS-TW
blurb: Continuous marquee carousel for logos or images with optional pause on hover.
description: Renders a horizontal or vertical scrolling loop of logos with configurable speed. Logos repeat seamlessly; supports pause-on-hover, scale animations, and optional fade edges.
use_when: Displaying partner, sponsor, or client logos in a continuous scrolling strip.
avoid_when: When images must be interactive or clickable beyond optional link wrapping, or when motion must respect prefers-reduced-motion fully.
a11y: Images accept alt text and optional titles. Links have aria-labels. Motion respects prefers-reduced-motion for transform changes but carousel still loops. Primary interaction is hover.
